theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ), a < b → ∃ F : C_c(Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n, ℝ), ∀ ν : Measure (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n), ν (closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) b ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≠ ∞ → ν (closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) a ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n))) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ z, F z ∂ν) ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ z, F z ∂ν) ≤ ν (closedBall (0 : Euclidean N) b ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)))
